# am_data_plane (Data Source)

DataPlane DataSource

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "am_data_plane" "my_dataplane" {
  environment_id  = "DEFAULT"
  id              = "acme-eu"
  organization_id = "DEFAULT"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Stable, immutable identifier for the data plane within its environment. Lowercase alphanumeric and hyphens, starting and ending with an alphanumeric character. This is the value a domain's dataPlaneId refers to.

### Optional

- `environment_id` (String) Identifier of the environment the data plane belongs to. Read-only.
- `organization_id` (String) Identifier of the organization the data plane belongs to. Read-only.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (ISO-8601 / RFC 3339, UTC). Read-only.
- `database` (String) Name of the database the configuration points at. Read-only.
- `gateway_url` (String) Base URL of the gateway serving the domains bound to this data plane. Must be an absolute http(s) URL with a lowercase scheme; omitted or empty leaves it unset.
- `hosts` (List of String) Hosts the configuration points at, as host:port. Read-only.
- `name` (String) Human-readable name of the data plane.
- `type` (String) Data plane plugin type identifier, matching the dataplane-am-<type> plugin. Immutable after creation.
- `updated_at` (String) Last-update timestamp (ISO-8601 / RFC 3339, UTC). Read-only.
